name: Quicksand
description: Launches, controls and snapshots QEMU virtual machines from async Python to sandbox AI agents, with Ubuntu and Alpine images and desktop control.

skills.name: Run Sandboxed Commands
skills.description: Runs shell commands in network-isolated Ubuntu or Alpine QEMU VMs from async Python, with no root or Docker needed.

skills.name: Checkpoint and Revert
skills.description: Checkpoints full VM state and reverts to it, or saves disk state to load later, even on another machine.

skills.name: Mounts and Port Forwards
skills.description: Mounts host directories into a sandbox at boot or on the fly, and forwards TCP ports between host and guest.

skills.name: Control a Desktop
skills.description: Controls Xfce desktop VMs with screenshots, typed text, key presses and mouse clicks for computer-use agents.

skills.name: Guest OS Users
skills.description: Creates separate Linux user accounts in one VM so several agents run commands with their own home directories.
